termsModal.title: Terms & Conditions
termsModal.notice: Please scroll down to read the complete terms and conditions before proceeding.
termsModal.sec1Item1: Bookings must be made at least 1 day in advance prior to the photo session.
termsModal.sec1Item2: Schedule rescheduling is permitted a maximum of 1 (one) time with at least 24 hours prior notice.
termsModal.sec1Item3: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled session begins for preparation and fitting.
termsModal.sec2Item1: A 50% Down Payment (DP) is required to secure your booking slot.
termsModal.sec2Item2: Settlement of remaining payment is due at the studio after the photo session.
termsModal.sec2Item3: We accept payments via Bank Transfer, E-Wallets, and QRIS.
termsModal.sec3Item1: Down Payment (DP) is non-refundable in case of client cancellation.
termsModal.sec3Item2: Grace period for tardiness is maximum 15 minutes. Beyond that, session duration will be reduced accordingly to avoid delaying subsequent clients.
termsModal.sec3Item3: If there is no contact (No-Show) after 30 minutes, the booking is forfeited.
termsModal.sec4Item1: Clients are fully responsible for any damage or loss of studio property caused by client negligence.
termsModal.sec4Item2: Morain Studio is not responsible for loss of personal belongings on studio premises.
termsModal.sec4Item3: Original photo softcopies are retained in our database for a maximum of 1 month. Please download promptly as we cannot be held responsible after this period.
